strings.subtitle: — Faal sabira —
strings.dnd_hint: (bee faal maa vuui na window ŋɔ ni)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Vuubu mini bɔhibu bi saɣiti. Zaŋ button din be gbunni ŋɔ.
strings.ssd_warning:
Nimmɔhi! SSD zuɣu, sabbu din nyɛ zuɣusaa bi saɣiti sabbu ka di nyɛla TRIM zuɣu.
Program ŋɔ nyɛla HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faal "{name}" yɛn sabi mi zuɣusaa ka yɛn nyɛhi.

Tuɣi?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAAL MAA SABI ZUƔUSAA KA NYƐHI
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS lahabali sabbu din pahi (ADS) bi tumdi tuma.
• USN gbaŋ bi nyɛhi.
• Shin kopi mini sagban tuma
  (OneDrive, atg.) bi tibgi.
strings.status_full: Lahabali din be di ni zaa sabi zuɣusaa ni zeeri. Di bi yɛn labi na — binkuraɣu ni nya zeeri ko.
strings.status_fast: Zuɣu, zuɣusaa nyɛlaŋ, ni 4 MB zoya sabi zuɣusaa. Din kpalim bi nyɛhi, amaa zolɔŋ zuɣu, din nyɛ zaɣ' yini labi na ni consumer binkuraɣu bi yɛn tooi. N-nyɛ gbaŋ biɛɣu, zaŋ MŊ GANNA nahingbana.
strings.status_empty: Faal maa daa nyɛla kuŋɔ, sabbu zuɣusaa daa bi di. Nyɛhi.
strings.error_permission: Ku tooi kpe faal maa ni. Di ni tooi nyɛ di yɔɣi program. Yɔɣi, labi niŋ.
strings.error_not_found: Faal maa bi yoli. Di ni tooi nyɛ di pun nyɛhi.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ŋɔ nyɛla dini teeŋi kpe. Dini teeŋi kpe ku tooi sabi — faal din dalimdi ŋɔ yɛn kpalim.
strings.error_reparse: Ŋɔ nyɛla zosim faal (OneDrive bee din ŋmani li). Di lahabali be sagban ni, ka bi be disk. Ka zosim n-nyɛ zaɣ' yini.
strings.error_not_file: Ŋɔ pala faal (folder bee binshiɛɣu). Zaŋ faal kulibɔ.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faal ŋɔ malila dini teeŋi kpe din kpe (n pahi {n} zaa). Dini teeŋi kpe din kpe ka tooni — yuli zaa nyɛla yim. A yi sabi ka di nyɛla sochibiga ŋɔ zuɣu, lahabali yɛn sabi zuɣusaa ka ŋmahi n dɔli 32 byte, amaa din kpalim yɛn nyɛla din nya ka di nyɛla dini teeŋi kpe din pahi. Nyiɛhi dini teeŋi kpe zaa piligu.
strings.error_compressed:
Faal maa nyɛla dini mɔɣi, dini suui bee nyɛla zaɣ' bihi. Sabbu zuɣusaa ni zeeri bi saɣiti lahabali kurili nyɛhibu ka di nyɛla NTFS malila so' shɛli din pahi.

Nyiɛhi kundi: right-click → Properties → Advanced → nyɛhi tiki din be "Compress" mini/be "Encrypt". Nimaani tum SHREDDER labi.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Faalinima {count} ni ti saɣim.
Zaŋ gbaŋ: {size}.

Yɛlimaŋli yuli maa.
Di ku tooi labi.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Yihima faalinima {count} zaa tuhibu ni?

Faalinima maa bɛ ni nyɛ — yuli maa ko.
strings.hardlink_text:
Faali "{name}" mali gbanpiihi links ({nlink} zaa).

Di saɣim data zaa.
Ammaa 32 bytes ni kpalim.

A ni tu ni a nyɛhi li.
